 KL Rahul Test Centuries List
 November 19, 2026 Individual Records 
 KL Rahul is someone you expect to score some of the hardest runs . He has been opening the batting for India for most of his Test career .
 And as you know, opening is the toughest task in Tests. The new ball moves a lot. And if the conditions are seamer-friendly, then things get trickier.
 But despite the challenges, Rahul has produced some brilliant centuries in the longest format.
 So here’s a look at centuries scored by KL Rahul in Test cricket.

 Key Insights on KL Rahul’s Test Centuries 
 KL Rahul’s Maiden Test Century Records
 Rahul brought up his maiden century in just his second Test. He scored 110 off 262 balls against Australia in the second innings of the 2015 Sydney Test.
 This made him the fifth-youngest Indian batter to score a Test century in Australia at the age of 22 years and 263 days .
 The 110-run mark also made him the joint third-fastest Indian batter to score their first Test ton, achieving the feat in just his third innings.
 Two days later, Rahul smashed his second Test century. This one, 108 off 190 balls , came against Sri Lanka in the first innings of the 2015 Colombo Test.
 Rahul was 23 years and 124 days old , making him the third-youngest Indian batter to score a Test hundred in Sri Lanka .
 Rahul scored his second Test century in his seventh innings , becoming the fifth-fastest Indian batter to the mark.
 KL Rahul’s Test Century Records against West Indies and Afghanistan
 In his 11th innings , the right-hander produced 158 off 303 balls against the West Indies in the 2016 Kingston Test. This made him the joint fourth-fastest Indian batter to score their third Test century.
 His 158 is the seventh-highest individual score by an Indian opener against the West Indies in Tests.
 Rahul laced the 158-run knock with three sixes , the joint second-most by an Indian batter against the West Indies in a Test innings.
 KL Rahul’s 100 against the West Indies in Ahmedabad made him the first Indian opener to score a Test hundred against them at home since 2018 .
 Rahul has registered the fourth-highest individual score for India against Afghanistan in Tests. He scored 100 off 165 balls in the first innings of the 2026 New Chandigarh Test.
 KL Rahul’s Career-Best Score and Impressive Test Century Records against England
 Rahul smashed his career-best Test score against England. He fell just one run short of a double, scoring 199 off 311 balls in the second innings of the 2016 Chennai Test.
 He became the second Indian and, overall, the ninth batter to get out on the score of 199 in a Test innings .
 His 199 is the fourth-highest individual score by an Indian opener against England in Tests.
 Rahul’s fourth Test hundred came in his 19th innings . This is the third-fewest innings an Indian batter has taken to score his fourth Test hundred.
 Rahul is the only Indian opener to score five centuries against England in Tests. He has scored four of those hundreds in England , again the most by an Indian opener.
 Notably, Rahul is one of the two Indian batters to score two or more Test centuries at Lord’s Cricket Ground . (Check out five legends who couldn’t score a Test hundred at Lord’s here !) 
 KL Rahul’s Test Century Records in South Africa
 Rahul is one of three Indian batters to smash two or more centuries in South Africa in Tests. 
 Interestingly, both of his hundreds have come at the SuperSport Park in Centurion , the only Indian with multiple Test centuries at this venue.
 The right-hander has also brought up the highest individual score as an Indian opener in South Africa in Tests. He smashed 123 off 260 balls in the first innings of the 2021 Centurion Test. This was the first century by an Indian opener in South Africa since January 2007 .
 Rahul also holds the third-highest Test score for India at No. 6 in South Africa and, overall, the fourth-highest for India in this batting position against them. He scored 101 off 137 balls at the same venue in 2023 .
